name: A Dip in the Moonwell
summary: A Dip in the Moonwell is a Horde task in Thousand Needles where the goblin tinkerer Wizlo Bearingshiner devises an underhanded scheme to gather sacred water. Rather than asking an adventurer to charge blindly into an Alliance garrison, he arranges the remote hijacking of a delivery automaton to burglarize Thalanaar's moonwell.

sections.title: A Matter of Discretion
sections.body: Approaching an Alliance border bastion in broad daylight with a ladle is practically suicidal for any Horde scout. Thalanaar sits proudly at the boundary separating Feralas from the canyon, guarded by sentinel archers and hip-deep in night elven sacred ground. To bypass the garrison's scrutiny, Wizlo Bearingshiner at Whitereach Post opts for espionage over bloodshed, setting his sights directly on the outpost's luminous moonwell.

sections.title: The Robotron 3000
sections.body: Wizlo's scheme relies on equipment he has no legal right to touch. Tasked with hauling cargo for a customer, the enterprising goblin quietly broke the factory seal on a Robotron 3000 unit. Setting up a hidden command relay in the brush across the rim from Thalanaar, he provides a portable remote control so an operative can pilot the mechanical contraption into the shrine unnoticed, scoop a vial of lunar water, and retreat before the sentinels or his client catch on.

faq.q: Why does Wizlo need water from Thalanaar?
faq.answer: Wizlo Bearingshiner needs pure moonwell water to brew an experimental tonic. Because the night elves jealously guard their sacred fonts, he cannot trade for it directly and must resort to theft.
The moonwell sits directly inside Thalanaar, the night elf outpost stationed along the forested ramp that connects the western rim of Thousand Needles to the lush highlands of Feralas.

The Robotron 3000 is an advanced mechanical unit manufactured for a third-party client. Wizlo was hired merely to transport it, but he cracked open the shipping crate without permission to use its remote operations for his heist.

faq.q: Where is the Concealed Command Console hidden?
faq.answer: The console is tucked inside a thick cluster of brush along the mesa rim opposite Thalanaar, overlooking the western approach into Feralas.

faq.q: How does the remote control work?
faq.answer: Standing near the concealed console on the mesa rim activates the link, transferring the operator's awareness directly into the mechanical chassis to guide it through the sentinels and into the well's basin.

Wizlo keeps the client's identity quiet, admitting only that whoever paid for the freight would hang him by his oversized ears if they discovered the automaton was unboxed and driven through the dust.

angles.text: The mission showcases typical goblin workshop ethics: bypassing danger entirely through unauthorized field-testing of fine-tuned client freight.
Whitereach Post relies on low-profile tactics to skirt the heavy night elf sentinel watch guarding the transit corridor between Thousand Needles and Feralas.
